in.title: 'We should win; there is no other result,' says Mohun Bagan coach ahead of ISL opener
in.description: Guwahati, Oct 11 (IANS) Mohun Bagan Super Giant head coach Panagiotis Dilmperis said his team must approach the new Indian Super League (ISL) season with greater aggression and intensity, insisting that winning is the only acceptable result as they prepare to face NorthEast United FC in their campaign opener on Monday. Mohun Bagan will take on NorthEast United at the Indira Gandhi Athletic Stadium on October 12, beginning their campaign with an away fixture. It will be the first of two consecutive away matches for the Kolkata-based side, who have already faced the Guwahati outfit in the Durand Cup this season. Dilmperis believes the team’s participation in multiple competitions during the pre-season has helped the players develop tactical flexibility and gain valuable match experience ahead of the ISL campaign. “Because we managed to work on two formations, we played 3-4-3, and we played 4-2-3-1. So, the players now, they adopt both of them, so we can use them in different games, or, during a game, we can switch. Most of the players have had playing time, and that playing time was under a lot of pressure because we wanted to take the title. The whole process was beneficial for us,” Dilmperis said. Custom Ad: Multiplex The coach also outlined his expectations for the team this season, saying he wants Mohun Bagan to play a more attacking brand of football, while acknowledging that the squad may need time to sustain that intensity throughout a match. “I would love to see on the field a team that plays something a little bit more aggressive, with more intensity. It’s true that because of the preparation season, we are not ready to do it for a long time during one game. We should win. There is no other result,” he added. Mohun Bagan enter the new campaign after a busy pre-season that included success in the IFA Shield and other tournaments, providing the squad with a strong platform ahead of the league. Forward Lee Harry Erwin also expressed confidence in the team’s atmosphere and preparation, saying the challenges faced during the season had helped strengthen the squad’s togetherness. “The atmosphere amongst the squad is very good, especially when you have the hurdles that we’ve had in the season. You see it in training; everybody’s happy together. We have two trophies as well. It’s good to build on this; it’s a good platform,” Erwin said. --IANS sds/bc

pk.title: CARKU 400W PB-113 Portable Power Station Wins the 2026 Global Sources Innovation Award
pk.description: HONG KONG, Oct. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Carku, a global leader in proprietary BMS design and smart battery integration, unveiled its latest portable power station lineup today at the Global Sources Consumer Electronics Show (AsiaWorld-Expo, Booth 5J24, East Hall). Leveraging Hong Kong's role as a global trading hub, Carku met face-to-face with longstanding partners and international buyers at its booth, together witnessing a milestone moment as Carku wins Global Sources Innovation Award for CARKU 400W PB-113 Portable Power Station at Global Sources Consumer Electronics Show. Global Sources Innovation Award winner CARKU PB-113 portable power station set up for outdoor camping Showcase Spotlight: CARKU PB-113 Redefines All-in-One Portable Power Anchored by the award-winning PB-113, Carku's energy storage lineup took center stage with a comprehensive range of models across diverse capacities. Building on its deep manufacturing expertise and flexible OEM/ODM capabilities, Carku showcased a full lineup of AC-powered energy solutions engineered for outdoor camping and emergency applications, delivering highly customizable options for global brand partners. 400W AC Output: Power for Every Scenario Equipped with continuous 400W AC output, PB-113 effortlessly supports daily electronics. It translates multi-scenario energy needs into a single, compact solution for off-grid travel support. Space-Saving, All-in-One Versatility Weighing just 5 kg, PB-113 saves up to 50% trunk space compared to traditional power stations. Equipped with smart jumper clamps featuring 10-stage safety protection, self-reliant drivers can safely jump-start dead batteries instantly with a single button. Built to Last: 3,000+ Cycle LiFePO4 Powered by premium LiFePO4 cells engineered for 3,000+ cycles, PB-113 maximizes energy density and thermal stability. Coupled with advanced BMS hardware, it provides real-time operating protection to deliver a dependable energy experience. Driving the Future of Multi-Scenario Power Safety is our non-negotiable foundation," said Carku leadership. "Winning this Innovation Award validates our approach: integrating emergency jump-starting and energy storage into an automotive-grade ecosystem for both roadside assistance and off-grid living. This multi-functional design directly hits market demand in Asia-Pacific, where disaster readiness and evolving grids drive off-grid power adoption. To accelerate regional rollout, Carku is executing its compliance roadmap—marked by its newly secured PSE certification in Japan—to deliver safe, dependable energy across the region. About CARKU CARKU provides OEM/ODM solutions spanning jump starters, starting batteries, and power stations, powered by LIFEBMS and 100W–3600W power capabilities. Backed by 852 patents and meeting CE, FCC, RoHS, and UL requirements. For more information, visit CARKU's website and follow us on Facebook.

ae.title: Amateur Uses Claude Code, Codex and NASA Data to Flag a Possible Exoplanet, and TESS Will Test It in November
ae.description: Every 3.18 days, a star sitting 116 light-years from Earth loses a tiny fraction of its brightness. The person who says he caught that pattern is Pavel Rabtsevich, a 28-year-old product manager based in Spain. He has no astronomy training and owns no telescope. His tools were AI coding agents and NASA data that anyone can download. Within a few weeks, a space telescope will check whether he got it right. That is why the story deserves a closer look. Nobody is making a loose claim that a chatbot "discovered a planet." Rabtsevich has made a precise prediction that can be proven wrong, with dates attached, and he has published those dates for anyone to see.“If the star dims on time in November, this gets a lot more serious,” Rabtsevich wrote in an X post laying out his results. “If it doesn’t, I’ll post that too.”The star and the signalThe star is TIC 4206066, which is slightly smaller than the Sun. The signal is a small, steady dip in its brightness every 3.18 Earth days. That is the kind of drop you would expect if an object were passing in front of the star. Rabtsevich estimates that the candidate planet would be a little more than 1.4 times the size of Earth. A planet whose year lasts just over three Earth days would be very hot, and he puts its surface temperature at roughly 1,000 degrees Fahrenheit. That is well above Mercury's temperature and hot enough to melt lead. He also found a second, fainter signal. The AI-assisted search picked up another dimming pattern on the same star, repeating every 11.13 Earth days, which could mean a second exoplanet that nobody has spotted before. Rabtsevich says the case for this one is weaker, and he deserves credit for saying so at the outset. Three AI agents, one person in chargeHis raw data came from the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS). The space telescope is run by MIT astronomers and was launched by NASA in 2018. TESS looks for planets beyond our solar system by measuring how bright stars are over time. When a star dims at regular intervals, a planet may be crossing in front of it and blocking part of its light. Rabtsevich used only a small part of that archive, recorded between November of last year and early January. He said it covered more than 126,000 stars. He gave the data to three agents: TypeSafe's Jev, Anthropic's Claude Code and OpenAI's Codex. He prompted them to search for dimming patterns, and with each round the list of candidates got shorter. He made it clear that he, not the models, was making the decisions.“I didn’t take the models’ first answers,” Rabtsevich said. “I pushed them, round after round, to improve their own methods, and checked what they gave me against other models. “I decided which tests to run, judged whether a result was strong enough, and chose what to keep.”If any AI-driven workflow deserves trust, it is one like this. Checking one model's output against another's is the cheapest protection against an answer that sounds confident but is wrong, and most people don't bother to do it.74 tests designed to prove him wrongAfter TIC 4206066 emerged as a candidate, Rabtsevich checked older records. He pulled the star's TESS observations from 2020 and 2018. Both years showed the same dips at the same frequency. He then used Claude Code to run 74 tests, each one meant to knock down his own hypothesis. In one test, he gave the agent two of the TESS datasets and asked it to predict when the dimming would show up in the third. It predicted correctly in all three cases. Rabtsevich sent the report to MIT and asked for TESS to observe TIC 4206066 the next time the telescope covers that part of the sky. MIT approved the request. Between October 31 and November 26, the telescope will measure the star's brightness every two minutes. Earlier this week, he published the exact times the star should dim during that period if a planet really is transiting it on a regular schedule. A dip in brightness is not yet a planetSome context helps here. Astronomers have already catalogued more than 6,400 exoplanets. Some orbit stars. Others, known as “rogue planets,” drift through space with nothing holding them in place, which fits the Greek root of “planet,” meaning “to wander.” Billions more are thought to exist. Over eight years of observations, TESS has found more than 1,000 exoplanet candidates that astronomers later confirmed. The transit method also has well-known pitfalls. A binary star system, for example, can easily look like a planet crossing in front of a star.“The biggest challenge with confirming planets is that we have to rule out false-positive scenarios,” said Kevin Hardegree-Ullman, a research scientist at the NASA Exoplanet Science Institute (NExScI). “This is difficult because: (1) there are just so many candidates… (2) we have limited telescopes… and we are generally competing with all other astronomers for time on these… and (3) some targets are not amenable to follow-up measurements with current telescopes (e.g., they are too faint to get a good signal other than a transit-like event).”Rabtsevich isn't overselling his result. He points out that correlation does not necessarily mean causation and that something other than a planet may turn out to cause the pattern. What AI is good for here, and what it isn'tAI does well at finding candidates. Confirming them is a separate job.NASA deployed an AI model a little under a year ago to sort through TESS data, and it has already identified around 7,000 exoplanets. Tools like Claude Code and Codex are available to the public, so they could also let amateurs like Rabtsevich join the search from well outside the scientific establishment.“AI tools won’t necessarily be helpful in the process of confirming planets,” Hardegree-Ullman said, “but [they] will likely continue to be used to string together publicly available code to help search for planets and run them through the basic vetting processes… ”For Rabtsevich, the main benefit was speed.“Without these tools I couldn’t have processed a data set this size and carried it through to a result,” he said. “Even a couple of years ago my job meant building endless spreadsheets and grinding through data sets, and that ate up a huge amount of time. Here, a search I planned went through 126,000 stars, and then dozens of tests ran on a single one, in about two weeks.”The flood of amateur candidates he's worried aboutHis post has already pulled other amateurs into planet hunting. Rabtsevich knows that is not entirely a good thing.“Since my [X] post, I’ve seen a lot of people start searching TESS data for planets themselves,” he said. “I hope that enthusiasm comes with careful checks, so professional astronomers aren’t left sorting through poorly vetted signals.”Hardegree-Ullman's point about limited telescope time makes that warning more serious. A surge of poorly checked AI candidates would use up the resource professionals have least of. Some readers are less cautious. In a Claude subreddit, one Redditor welcomed an AI story that wasn't about slop: “There is an awful lot of absolute shite made with the use of AI,” the user wrote. “But this… this is fucking incredible. Well done.”It is too early to celebrate. If TIC 4206066 dims on the schedule Rabtsevich published for October 31 to November 26, his method will have earned the praise. If it doesn't, he has promised to say so publicly, and that promise is the most credible part of the story.

ae.title: Dubai Police sets four priorities to boost emergency response and AI-powered operations by 2033
ae.description: Dubai: Dubai Police is expanding the use of artificial intelligence and smart technologies to improve emergency response, strengthen operational readiness and support faster, more accurate decision-making under its Operations Strategy 2033. His Excellency Lieutenant General Abdulla Khalifa Al Marri, Commander-in-Chief of Dubai Police, reviewed the strategy, operational performance, development projects and emerging technologies during his annual inspection of the General Department of Operations. The strategy is built around four priorities: rapid emergency response, institutional readiness and resilience, technical support and smart technology, and sustainable communication. During the inspection, Al Marri reviewed the mechanisms through which Dubai Police receives and manages reports and incidents, from the initial call and assessment stage to incident classification, deployment of resources and coordination of response efforts. He was also briefed on procedures for routine and exceptional circumstances, including plans to ensure uninterrupted operations and effective coordination between control rooms, patrols, field teams and relevant authorities. Al Marri stressed that effective emergency management depends on preparedness, accurate and timely information, and the ability to respond flexibly to different situations. He called for the continuous development of operational procedures and regular assessments of readiness to ensure teams remain capable of responding to emerging challenges. The Commander-in-Chief also reviewed artificial intelligence technologies and smart solutions being used to support security operations, improve efficiency, accelerate procedures and make greater use of operational data. He was briefed on plans to expand the use of AI across police operations to enable more proactive, flexible and efficient working methods. Al Marri stressed that advanced technology should support police personnel by enabling faster and more informed decision-making and enhancing the accuracy of responses to incidents. He called for continued investment in AI solutions that deliver tangible improvements in security operations and public safety. According to Dubai Police, the Operations Strategy 2033 aims to support the emirate's continued growth and evolving security requirements through four key priorities: improving the speed and effectiveness of emergency responses, strengthening institutional readiness and resilience, enhancing operational capabilities through advanced technologies and artificial intelligence, and maintaining effective communication and coordination across teams and relevant entities. Al Marri said the strategy must be translated into practical initiatives and projects with measurable outcomes. He also highlighted the importance of anticipating future challenges, developing multiple response scenarios and ensuring police operations remain effective and adaptable. The inspection also highlighted employee wellbeing indicators within the General Department of Operations. Internal employee happiness reached 99.8 per cent, while the employee motivation rate stood at 100 per cent. Al Marri praised the results, noting that police personnel remain central to the success of operational services. He said investment in employee skills, development and motivation directly enhances performance, service quality and operational readiness. He also thanked employees of the General Department of Operations for their efforts in protecting the community and supporting Dubai's security. Al Marri stressed the importance of teamwork, continuous training, knowledge sharing and investing in national talent to maintain high levels of readiness and professionalism. He encouraged teams to embrace innovation, anticipate emerging challenges and develop practical solutions rather than relying solely on previous achievements. During the inspection, Al Marri toured the department's facilities, reviewed operational systems and equipment, and received briefings on coordination mechanisms between different teams and units. He also honoured a number of outstanding employees for their contributions to improving performance and achieving organisational objectives, while recognising several retired personnel for their years of service and contributions to Dubai Police and the community.

iq.description: نينوى - شفق نيوز رفعت إدارة مشروع سد الموصل، صباح اليوم الأحد، معدل التصريف المائي المطلق باتجاه مجرى نهر دجلة إلى 750 متراً مكعباً في الثانية، في وقت أكدت فيه الشرطة النهرية عدم وجود مخاطر تستدعي إطلاق تحذيرات للمناطق والمقتربات النهرية. وقال مصدر في إدارة سد الموصل لوكالة شفق نيوز، إن "التصريف المطلق من السد جرى تعديله ليصبح 750 متراً مكعباً في الثانية بدلاً من 600 متر مكعب في الثانية، بدءاً من الساعة العاشرة من صباح اليوم الأحد". وبيّن المصدر أن هذا الإجراء جاء وفق خطة التشغيل المعتمدة والتوجيهات المركزية الصادرة من المركز الوطني لإدارة الموارد المائية لتنظيم الحصص المائية في حوض النهر. من جانبها، أوضحت مفارز الشرطة النهرية في نينوى، أنها أبلغت القرى والمقتربات والمنشآت الواقعة على ضفاف نهر دجلة بالزيادة الحاصلة كإجراء روتيني للمتابعة، مؤكدة أنها لم توجه أي تحذيرات أو إنذارات إخلاء نظراً لكون هذه الإطلاقات تقع ضمن الحدود التشغيلية الطبيعية والآمنة التي يستوعبها المجرى دون أي خطورة.

tr.title: Tümer Metin'den Fenerbahçe için bomba iddia
tr.description: Tümer Metin, Fenerbahçe'nin Rizespor deplasmanında aldığı galibiyeti değerlendirdi. Metin, sarı-lacivertlilerin Aston Villa'yla oynayacağı maçla ilgili de dikkat çeken bir iddiada bulundu. Trendyol Süper Lig'de 2026/27 sezonunun 7. haftasında Fenerbahçe, Rizespor deplasmanında Marco Asensio, İrfan Can Kahveci ve Oğuz Aydın'ın golleriyle 3-0 kazandı. Sarı-lacivertliler aldığı galibiyetle puanını 13'e yükseltti. Mücadelenin ardından Tümer Metin, Tivibu Spor'da katıldığı yayında Fenerbahçe'nin Rizespor karşısında aldığı galibiyeti yorumladı. Metin maçın ardından yaptığı açıklamada, “Çok ekonomik buldum Fenerbahçe'yi. Sanıyorum İsmail hoca 3 maçlık bir plan yapmış ki teknik adamlar bunu yaparlar. Derli toplu buldum. Maçın başında bulunan gol. Kilit nasıl açılacak diye düşünürken en güvendiğiniz adamdan gelmiş olması. Uzun süre oynamadığı, eksikliğinin hissedildiği ve zorlu bir deplasman... Asensio'nun golü bulmuş olması onu da bir tık yukarıya taşıyacaktır. Hala tam hazır değil oyunda kaldığı süre için söylüyorum. Ama bu tip oyuncular sahada kalarak, süre alarak form tutarlar. Bir tık yukarıya taşıyacağı kanaatindeyim. Gol de yardımcı olur buna. Derli toplu buldum Fenerbahçe'yi. Guendouzi-Kante defansın önünde. Kante-Skriniar, Ake-Guendouzi uyumu. Birbirlerinin kademelerine girmeleri. Rakibi oraya sokmamaları. Sanki bir şeylerin inşa edilmiş ve yerine oturmuş görüntüsündeydi." Aston Villa maçıyla ilgili sözlerine devam eden Tümer Metin, “Bundan önce üzerine tartıştığımız oyuncular vardı. Acaba Oğuz tercihi doğru olabilir mi? Bence de bir planın parçası. Muhtemelen çarşamba günü başlayacaktır Oğuz'la.” açıklamasında bulundu. Ederson'un performansına değinen Metin, “Hep söylerim, bu ligde şampiyon olacaksan golcün 20'li çift haneleri bulacak, kaleciniz de istisnasız size 5 maç kazandıracak. Bugün bu maçı Ederson kazandırdı diyeceğim 5 maç alacak. Geçen sene, ondan önceki seneler Fenerbahçe'nin içine düştüğü 1-0 buhranında, son anlar için söylüyorum Ederson'un da yardım etmediği haftalar vardı geçen sene. Ama bugün üzerine düşeni yaptı. Sezon başında beri iyi oynadığını belirtelim. Muhtemelen Aziz başkan dokunmuş. Ederson'un o güveni aldığını düşünüyorum çünkü işlerin koptuğu noktaya gelmişti.” ifadelerini kullandı. Oğuz Aydın için Tümer Metin ayrıca, “Belki Kerem'i oyunda tutarak Oğuz Aydın'a daha az süre vermiş olmasına rağmen çarşamba günü başlayacağının sinyali olabilir.” açıklamasında bulundu.

tn.title: 19 أكتوبر.. الأكاديمية البرلمانية تنظم يوما دراسيا حول مقترح القانون الأساسي المتعلق بالهياكل الرياضية
tn.description: تنظم الأكاديمية البرلمانية يوم الاثنين 19 أكتوبر 2026، يوما دراسيا برلمانيا حول مقترح القانون الأساسي المتعلق بالهياكل الرياضية وذلك بداية من الساعة التاسعة والنصف صباحا بقاعة راضية الحداد بمقر مجلس نواب الشعب. ويندرج هذا اليوم الدراسي في إطار دراسة مقترح القانون المذكور المتعلق بالإطار القانوني المنظم للهياكل الرياضية وما يطرحه من مسائل تتعلق بتسيير هذه الهياكل وتنظيم نشاطها وتطوير حوكمتها. وستتناول الأشغال النسخة المعدّلة من مقترح القانون في سياق مواصلة لجنة التربية والتكوين المهني والبحث العلمي والشباب والرياضة بمجلس نواب الشعب النظر في فصوله والاستئناس بآراء الخبراء ومختلف المتدخلين في الشأن الرياضي تمهيدا لاستكمال مناقشته والتصويت على أحكامه. ويهدف مقترح القانون الذي تقدمت به مجموعة من النواب وأحيل إلى اللجنة البرلمانية المختصة في ماي 2025 إلى إرساء إطار تشريعي أكثر ملاءمة للتطورات التي يشهدها القطاع الرياضي من خلال تطوير حوكمة الهياكل الرياضية وتحسين طرق تسييرها وتعزيز شفافية التصرف في مواردها المالية بما يدعم استدامة نشاطها ويرتقي بأدائها. ومن أبرز المحاور التي شملتها النقاشات البرلمانية السابقة شروط الترشح لتسيير الهياكل الرياضية وضبط مدة المسؤوليات وتنظيم الانتخابات ومنع تضارب المصالح إلى جانب تطوير آليات التمويل والتوفيق بين تشجيع الاستثمار في المجال الرياضي والمحافظة على استقلالية القرار الرياضي وهوية الأندية. ومن المنتظر، أن يتم خلال هذا اليوم مزيد تعميق النقاش بشأن الصيغة المعدّلة للمقترح وتبادل وجهات النظر حول مدى استجابته لانتظارات الرياضيين ومختلف مكونات المنظومة الرياضية فضلا عن تعزيز فرص صياغة نص تشريعي قابل للتطبيق ويستجيب لمتطلبات إصلاح القطاع وتحديثه. ويأتي هذا المسار التشريعي في ظل تزايد الحاجة إلى مراجعة الإطار القانوني المنظم للهياكل الرياضية بما يواكب التحولات التي يشهدها النشاط الرياضي ويكرّس مبادئ الحوكمة الرشيدة والشفافية والمساءلة ويدعم قدرة الرياضة التونسية على تحقيق نتائج مستدامة على المستويين الوطني والدولي.

mg.title: HALTÉROPHILIE – JUNIORS - Les Malgaches réalisent une razzia
mg.description: À Mostaganem, en Algérie, Madagascar frappe fort aux Championnats d’Afrique d’haltérophilie des jeunes et des juniors 2026. Tendry Tsiky Mahay Tia et Voharimboninahitra Ralijaona ont brillé aux Championnats d’Afrique des jeunes et des juniors 2026, en Algérie, en remportant à eux deux neuf médailles d’or. Cette moisson exceptionnelle est marquée par un record continental à l’épaulé-jeté, confirmant le potentiel de la relève malgache sur la scène africaine. Chez les filles, Tendry Tsiky Mahay Tia a fait parler sa puissance dans la catégorie des 62 kg. Avec 62 kg soulevés à l’arraché et 78 kg à l’épaulé-jeté, la jeune championne s’offre six médailles d’or, chez les cadettes et les juniors. Une performance de premier plan pour celle qui s’apprête désormais à porter les espoirs malgaches sur une autre scène internationale. La prochaine échéance est déjà en ligne de mire : les Jeux olympiques de la jeunesse de Dakar 2026. Qualifiée pour ce rendez-vous, Tendry représentera Madagascar et le continent africain dans quelques semaines. De quoi aborder cette compétition avec confiance, après cette démonstration de force en terre algérienne. Chez les garçons, Voharimboninahitra Ralijaona n’a pas été en reste. Le jeune leveur de fonte a décroché trois médailles d’or grâce à deux barres impressionnantes : 82 kg à l’arraché et 110 kg à l’épaulé-jeté. Cerise sur le gâteau, cette dernière performance lui permet d’établir un nouveau record d’Afrique dans la catégorie des jeunes. Record continental Cet exploit renforce l’éclat de la campagne malgache. Avec neuf médailles d’or et un record continental, les deux champions mettent en lumière le potentiel de l’haltérophilie nationale et le travail accompli pour faire émerger une nouvelle génération compétitive. Pour Madagascar, ces résultats dépassent le simple tableau des médailles. Ils nourrissent les ambitions à l’approche des prochains rendez-vous internationaux et font rayonner les couleurs nationales. À Dakar, Tendry Tsiky Mahay Tia aura désormais l’occasion de confirmer sur la scène olympique de la jeunesse les promesses affichées en Algérie. En attendant, la Grande Île peut savourer cette razzia dorée et ce nouvel exploit continental. L’hymne national « Ry Tanindrazanay malala ô ! » a résonné sur les podiums africains, tandis que les haltérophiles malgaches ont une nouvelle fois démontré leur puissance. Leur discipline figure parmi les pourvoyeuses de breloques dorées sur la scène internationale. Donné Raherinjatovo
